title: A single-cell and spatial 3D multi-omic atlas of developing human basal ganglia
title_zh: 发育期人类基底神经节的单细胞和空间 3D 多组学图谱
abstract: Human basal ganglia (BG) neurons and inhibitory interneurons originate in the ganglionic eminences (GEs), transient structures in the ventral prenatal brain. This study delineates the specification and maturation of GEs and GE-derived neurons using single-nucleus methyl-3C sequencing (snm3C-seq), spatial transcriptomics, and single-molecule chromatin + RNA imaging, and we found heterogeneous temporal progression across GE subregions. Spiny projection neurons (SPNs), the principal cells of the BG, acquire distinct subtypes through synchronized 3D-epigenomic remodeling, in contrast to the asynchronous maturation of other neuron types. Oligodendrocyte differentiation involves a transient short-range chromatin state during infancy, showing that the short-range and long-range chromatin conformations previously linked to terminal glial and neuronal fates can also be transient. The temporal cortex matured epigenomically faster than other cortical regions during this period. Lastly, SPNs were enriched in genetic risk for neuropsychiatric disease. Our study extends findings on unique 3D-epigenomic dynamics during human brain development.
abstract_zh: 人类基底神经节（BG）神经元和抑制性中间神经元起源于神经节隆起（GEs），这是产前腹侧大脑中的暂时性结构。本研究利用单核甲基化-3C测序（snm3C-seq）、空间转录组学以及单分子染色质 + RNA 成像，阐明了GEs及其衍生神经元的指定与成熟过程，并发现各GE子区之间存在异质的时间进展。基底神经节的主要细胞棘状投影神经元（SPN）通过同步的3D表观基因组重塑获得不同亚型，而其他神经元类型则表现为异步成熟。少突胶质细胞分化涉及婴儿期的一种短程染色质状态，表明此前与终末胶质细胞和神经元命运相关的短程和远程染色质构象也可以是暂时性的。在此期间，颞叶皮层的表观基因组成熟速度快于其他皮层区域。最后，SPN在神经精神疾病遗传风险中呈现富集。本研究拓展了关于人脑发育期间独特的3D表观基因组动力学的发现。
